# Nazmul Hoque

> AI-powered web developer and SEO specialist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build fast Next.js and WordPress websites and run SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), GEO (generative engine optimization), Google Ads and Meta Ads for local businesses and growing brands. I work with clients worldwide.

## Services
- Next.js websites: fast, mobile-first, server-rendered sites built with Next.js, React and TypeScript.
- WordPress development: custom themes, Elementor or Gutenberg builds, speed optimization, WooCommerce stores.
- SEO: technical, on-page and local SEO for any website (Next.js, WordPress or custom code).
- AEO: content structured for featured snippets and voice answers.
- GEO: structured data and clear content that AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can understand and cite.
- Google Ads and Meta Ads: campaign setup, conversion tracking, landing pages.

## Proof
- Local business website built and optimized by Nazmul Hoque: 7.21K organic clicks and 415K impressions in 12 months, average position 9.8 (Google Search Console).
- Same site, Feb-May 2026 vs the same period in 2025: clicks 232 to 1.64K (about 7x), impressions 8.98K to 105K (about 11.7x). 100% organic, no paid ads. Client name and domain withheld for privacy.
